 Print Scout OP’s mother has spoken out after the latest promotional clip of Bigg Boss 20 featuring her son sparked fresh discussions on social media. She shared an emotional voice note on Instagram, questioning the makers’ approach to editing and presenting his journey on the reality show. She alleged that selective editing and clips taken out of context were creating a misleading impression of Scout, also known as Tanmay Singh, among viewers. Her reaction comes after the makers released a new promo showing Scout shaving off his hair following a heated argument with fellow contestant Love Gill . She said, “Jab ek maa hone ke naate main khud ko is situation mein rakhkar dekhti hoon, toh mujhe yaad aata hai ki jab show ke host Salman sir ka ek edited promo saamne aaya tha, tab unhe khud aakar logon ko samjhana pada tha ki is tarah ke fake promos se galat perception create ho sakta hai. Aaj wahi cheez apne bete ke saath hote dekhkar bahut takleef hoti hai.” Watch Bigg Boss 20: Salman Khan’s Trolling Rant Sparks Industry Support; Kunal Kohli, Varun React She further pointed out that Scout has a life and career outside the reality show and that his portrayal on television could have consequences beyond his time inside the house. She added, “Scout show ke bahar bhi ek zindagi jeeta hai. Uska career hai, uske apne relationships hain aur use aage bhi kaam karna hai. Usne kai baar saaf-saaf apni baat rakhi hai aur apne relationships ko lekar bhi har sawaal ka jawab diya hai. Lekin iske bawajood baar-baar unhi baaton ko alag-alag tareekon se dikhaya ja raha hai. ” She said, “Aapki taraf se bhi kaha gaya tha ki gaanon aur edits ke zariye kisi ki image ko alag tarah se project nahi kiya jaata hai, lekin baar-baar wahi cheezein dohrayi ja rahi hain. Kabhi purane clips ko jodkar, kabhi baaton ko beech se kaatkar aur kabhi bilkul alag-alag maukon ke videos ko jodkar promotion banaya ja raha hai. Isse ek aisi kahani saamne aati hai jo poori sachchai se bilkul alag hai.” ‘Aakhir ek insaan ko kitna mentally push kiya jayega?’ The emotional voice note also reflected her concerns about her son’s mental well-being. Woh pehle hi bahut pressure mein hai aur kai baar apni takleef bhi zahir kar chuka hai. Use is had tak mental stress se guzarte dekhne ke bawajood baar-baar unhi baaton ko uthakar gaanon aur edits ke zariye promotion kiya ja raha hai aur ek nayi narrative banayi ja rahi hai. Aakhir ek insaan ko kitna mentally push kiya jayega?” Clarifying that she was not asking the makers for any special privileges, Scout’s mother requested that her son be given a fair opportunity to present his side. She also emphasised that his statements should be shown with their complete context rather than being edited selectively. She said, “Main kisi special treatment ki maang nahi kar rahi hoon. Bas itna chahti hoon ki mere bete ke saath bhi fairness ho. Uski baaton ko poora dikhaya jaaye, unka context kaatkar nahi. Use bhi apni baat rakhne ka aur apni image ko lekar pareshaan hue bina is safar ko poora karne ka mauka mile.” Join conversation

 Concluding her message, she reminded viewers and the makers that the consequences of a reality show’s portrayal can extend well beyond its runtime. She added, “Aakhir woh bhi kisi ka beta hai. Uski bhi ek zindagi hai, uske bhi sapne hain aur uska bhi ek future hai. Ek show aur uska promotion kuch waqt ke liye hota hai, lekin uska asar kisi insaan ki zindagi aur mental health par bahut lambe waqt tak reh sakta hai.” The voice note comes after the makers released a new promo showing an intense disagreement between Scout and Love Gill. The argument reportedly began after Scout made a remark about Love’s pyjamas, which she found inappropriate.
